title: nixos/linkding: add options to configure process and thread counts
structural_notes: Diff also touches the .ini rendering lines (processes/threads interpolation) but the watched set is the two new mkOption declarations (processes, threads) plus baseline enable. A sibling test nixos/tests/web-apps/linkding-postgres.nix also exists and is wired in all-tests.nix but was not used as the primary test target (linkding.nix matches the module basename).
